estimates.assumptions: 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce ≈ 30 ml / 40 g; typical values for commercial Thai-style sweet chilli sauce
zest of 1 medium orange ≈ 6 g; negligible macros except minor carbs
2 tbsp orange juice ≈ 30 ml from the same orange; typical juice values
1 tbsp Thai red curry paste ≈ 15 g; typical commercial paste values
8 raw chicken drumsticks with skin and bone ≈ 1100 g total (≈ 137 g each); standard raw values used, skin-on as typical for drumsticks; all 8 contribute to the whole recipe
